Title: Some thoughts on hosting email
Description:
Generally speaking, email isn't as hard as its reputation would suggest.
Yes, big-tech providers will occasionally send my messages to spam...
but paying for commercial email doesn't guarantee delivery:
emails within a single provider are generally safe, but in my experience, big-tech to other big-tech has a ~75% chance.

Title: The distrust is natural — Simon Gray's blog
Description: Lately, I have been thinking about how people respond psychologically to LLM use. The honeymoon phase is over, and generative AI now affects nearly every part of society. The speed of this change is revolutionary, almost in the literal sense. And society is reacting. More and more people are integrating AI into their personal workflows, but negative reactions to AI use are growing alongside it.
